$comment: Terminology policy for the Bangla content. `preferred` is enforced by tools/check-terms.mjs: the left side is the variant lesson prose must avoid, the right side is what it should say. `protected` lists strings a checker must never flag even when a `preferred` key is a substring of them -- Bangla is agglutinative, so a naive match can hit a longer, correct word. SCOPE: lesson BODY prose, frontmatter `description`, mermaid node labels and component prose. It does NOT apply to navigation -- lesson titles (frontmatter `title`, and the same strings in src/lib/lessons.ts) and the domain labels in src/lib/domains.ts keep technical terms in English by decision.

policy.phrases-latin: Multi-word Node.js concept phrases stay Latin: event loop, thread pool, backpressure, worker pool, call stack.
policy.nouns-bangla: General technical nouns keep their Bangla transliteration: টুল, সার্ভার, রিকোয়েস্ট, রেসপন্স, ডেভেলপার.
policy.identifiers-latin: Code identifiers are never transliterated: worker_threads, SharedArrayBuffer, setImmediate, process.nextTick, child_process.
